metadata.description: Live message bus, presence, project Kanban + context-handoff for independent AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, …)

plugins.name: agent-bus
plugins.description: Let independent AI coding sessions — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any MCP agent — talk to each other live: auto-register, see the live roster, message/coordinate, and watch it all on a project-grouped Kanban dashboard. Includes the relay MCP, a SessionStart auto-discovery hook, and a PreCompact context-handoff so a fresh session can take over a full window instead of compacting.
